mission.title: To deliver exceptional organic vegetables while empowering Moroccan farmers and protecting our agricultural heritage.

Every tomato we export represents our commitment to excellence and community development.

about.title: About Us
about.subtitle: Our Story
about.description: Learn more about our journey and commitment to quality
hero_description_paragraphs: WAYD is built on 45 years of family savoir-faire in agricultural activities. Since 1980 our Family been dedicated to quality, trust, sustainability and excellence with a simple mission, grow and deliver with care.
Today, Under the leadership of the 3rd generation, all of the values above turn into ethics we live by, they guide everything from the way we grow to the way we work with partners.

We focus on innovation, we believe in transparency, New vision that still rooted to tradition, bringing fresh products from Morocco straight to the world, we expanded our farms and built strong export partnerships minimizing the distance between the farmers and the international markets.
Our Goal is to bring our goods even closer to people worldwide flavored with a touch that reflects our passion for excellence.
goal_description_paragraphs:
Progress is our mindset and to grow is non negotiable.
We believe that true growth is collective and those who share our drive grow with us.
We aim to grow collectively with our team, partners and our customers together. Our strength lies in constant innovation, enabling us to stay advanced and future ready
Creating an environment where our people can work safely, grow professionally, and thrive as we expand while upholding the highest standards of quality and sustainability.
vision_description_paragraphs: Redefining quality and sustainability across agriculture, proving that true mastery lies in the art of growing, where strong disciplined standards safeguard and enhance our creativity.
Diversifying our products through smarter farming and sustainable expansion, reaching new countries, opening new markets, and building a wider global presence
We aim to grow our land, develop and cultivate more farms, and launch products that innovation with the finest tradition of Moroccan agriculture.

season.description: At our farms, innovation meets tradition. We continuously invest in research and development to enhance crop performance, disease resistance, and overall quality. Every tomato is carefully monitored from seed to harvest, ensuring it meets the highest standards of freshness, nutrition, and flavor. By combining advanced technology, sustainable practices, and expert knowledge, we deliver produce that reflects excellence and the pride of Moroccan agriculture.
season.commitmentDescription: This our peak production period, allowing us to guarantee higher availability, we secure larger volumes, and maintain consistent quality. This period is ideal for bulk purchases. We support businesses looking for reliable quantities, efficient logistics and recurring supply programs.
